description: Use this when a user asks how wholesale electricity prices have changed over recent days or weeks in a country, or whether power is getting cheaper. Returns the daily median and typical range of hourly day-ahead prices in euro per MWh, with the change over the period, from our daily snapshots of official data. Do not use for household bills. After 10 free calls a day per caller this tool costs USD 0.02 per answered call, paid with x402 (USDC); a 402 reply lists how. Nothing is charged for "not enough records" or errors.

commodity.description: electricity (default) or gas. gas returns wholesale natural-gas hub prices where a country has them (see the country notes); prices are per GJ or MWh as the answer states.

country.description: AU = Australia (National Electricity Market, five regions; prices in Australian dollars per MWh, not euro); AU = Australia (with commodity=gas: AEMO Short Term Trading Market hubs Adelaide, Brisbane, Sydney; prices in Australian dollars per GJ); DE = Germany (Germany/Luxembourg bidding zone, SMARD day-ahead hourly auction prices); Day-ahead wholesale power for ES = Spain and PT = Portugal (Iberian market, OMIE); Day-ahead wholesale power for AT = Austria, BE = Belgium, DK = Denmark, FR = France, IT = Italy, NL = the Netherlands, NO = Norway, PL = Poland (Germany is DE, served separately); Spot wholesale power for GB = Great Britain (Elexon market index, in pounds per MWh); JP = Japan (JEPX day-ahead spot market, half-hourly, in yen per kWh)

days.description: How many recent days to include. Default 30.

hub.description: AU gas only: STTM hub ADL (Adelaide), BRI (Brisbane) or SYD (Sydney, default); short names like NSW, QLD or SA also work.

lookback_days.description: How many recent days of hourly prices to include. Default 7, at most 14. AU: 1 to 7 trading days of five-minute prices (default 3); each five-minute interval counts as one record. Prices are in Australian dollars (AUD) per MWh. AU gas: 1 to 7 gas days (default 7); each hub gas day counts as one record, so ask for at least 5. Prices are in Australian dollars (AUD) per GJ. DE: 1 to 14 days of hourly prices (default 7); each hour counts as one record. ES/PT: 1 to 14 days of hourly average prices (default 7); each hour counts as one record. AT/BE/DK/FR/IT/NL/NO/PL: 1 to 14 days of hourly average prices (default 7); each hour counts as one record. GB: 1 to 14 days of half-hourly prices (default 7); each half-hour with traded volume counts as one record. JP: 1 to 14. The headline figure is always the newest complete delivery day (48 half-hours); lookback_days adds the daily medians of the earlier days we hold under extra.daily.

market.description: Which wholesale market. Only day-ahead (the next-day hourly auction) is available. AU: spot only (AEMO's five-minute regional price), not day-ahead; leave it out. AU gas: daily hub price (STTM ex post), not day-ahead; leave it out. DE: day-ahead only (the hourly auction held the day before delivery). ES/PT: day-ahead only (the auction held the day before delivery). AT/BE/DK/FR/IT/NL/NO/PL: day-ahead only (the auction held the day before delivery). GB: the half-hourly spot market index (traded prices); the day-ahead option is not used. Prices are in pounds, not euro. JP: day-ahead only (the spot market cleared the day before delivery). Prices are in yen per kWh, not euro per MWh.

months.description: Instead of days: how many whole months of monthly history to return, where a source has loaded long history.

region.description: AU only: NEM region NSW1 (New South Wales incl. ACT, default), QLD1, SA1, TAS1 or VIC1; short names like NSW, VIC or Queensland also work.

zone.description: Bidding zone, only where a country has more than one: DK = DK1 (west, default) or DK2 (east). IT answers northern Italy (IT-North), NO south-west Norway (NO2); other countries have one zone.

name: pricepaid_wholesale_power_price_history

outputSchema.description: A daily series from the ProofPrice price library: date, median, typical range and sample size, with the change over the period.

change.description: Change over the period; null with fewer than two days.

sample_size_note.description: Present when the publisher gives no record count: sample_size in the series is null.

source.description: Where the figure comes from, under which licence, and the attribution line to show.

attribution.description: The attribution line to show with the figure.

url.description: The publisher's page for this data.

title: Wholesale electricity price history
